Another challenge in using probiotics as nutrition therapy 
is the diﬃ  culty in maintaining the viability of the organisms. 
Heat, light, and aging are just some of the issues that can aﬀ ect

Currently the FDA does not allow for any health claims regard-
ing probiotics, but has established manufacturing guidelines.56
